descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S18 「服务端换日和 18 h 记录窗口之后的状态排序；日期错的设备上顺序一样」 Status sort after the server-side day roll and the 18 h note window; same order on a wrong-date device

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Hospital: 'QA Hosp Aged-Note' post-rounded with a note generated 19 h ago (room 2); 'QA Hosp Aged-Pre' pre-rounded, pre-round processed on the previous server (UTC) calendar day, no encounter or note (room 4); 'QA Hosp Fresh-Pending' pending (room 3); 'QA Hosp Fresh-Pre' pre-rounded today (room 1). …

When Open each list (the lifecycle runs on route entry and every 10 min) and choose the status sort. Repeat on the wrong-date device. Note the local time at which a pre-rounded patient flips to Pending, against the physician's local midnight

Then Aged-Note and Aged-Pre both show Not Yet Prepped / Pending. They sort inside that group with Fresh-Pending, ties in room order (Aged-Note 2, Fresh-Pending 3, Aged-Pre 4), and Fresh-Pre stays Pre-Rounded after them. The wrong-date device shows identical labels and order

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.6 (note 18 h) and 3.8 (server clock; a wrong-date device shows the same state) applied to U2/U7. A tester compares labels and card order on the two devices. The roll time against local midnight is recorded for Q14, not judged. Device-clock effects are a known issue (TFA-92584): report a wrong-date difference as 'Fail (known: TFA-92584)'

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）（TIME (back-dated seed: noteGeneratedAt -19 h, notesProcessedAt on the previous server day; the lifecycle runs on route entry)）；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
